Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 100.20 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.487 is the latest returned weekly observation for Oct 23, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • No FOMC decision is scheduled this week. The Board calendar sets minutes for the Oct 27-28 meeting on Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET; the next FOMC meeting is Dec 8-9 and the meeting calendar does not specify decision or press-conference times.
  • Selected Fed statistical releases: H.15 on Wed Nov 4 at 4:15 PM ET, H.4.1 on Thu Nov 5 at 4:30 PM ET, and H.8 on Fri Nov 6 at 4:15 PM ET, each on its own Board-calendar date list. Chicago Fed NFCI is set for Wed Nov 4 at 8:30 AM ET for the week ending Oct 30.
  • Official liquidity observations are lagged: SOFR 3.94% effective Oct 29; NFCI -0.487 for the week ending Oct 23. MOVE 100.20 is moderate and the official 10-year Treasury close is 4.94%. These are context measures, not live funding or rate quotes.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: New York Fed and Census align on Nov 2 construction, Nov 3 manufacturing orders and Nov 4 trade data. The Chicago Fed calendar confirms NFCI on Nov 4 and its NFCI page gives the regular Wednesday 8:30 AM ET time. Board statistical items are listed only on dates in their own Board calendar rows. New York Fed calendars are tentative and subject to change.
  • BEA schedule lists GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits for Nov 25 at 8:30 AM, and lists Personal Income and Outlays for October 2026 on Dec 2. The New York Fed November calendar separately lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM but gives no period. This date/period difference is not resolved in the checked pages; that PCE item is included only as the New York Fed calendar names it, with period not stated. Do not infer that it is the October report. BLS.gov was not requested; BLS release dates and ET times (CPI, PPI, JOLTS, Employment Situation) are sourced to the New York Fed calendar.
  • EIA confirms the next petroleum report is Nov 12 at noon for data week ending Nov 6, and natural-gas storage is Nov 13 at 10:30 AM. TreasuryDirect records verify 13- and 26-week bills closing Nov 2 at 11:30 AM and a 6-week bill closing Nov 3 at 11:30 AM. No other Treasury auction is inferred from the returned records. Routine CP items and other non-material statistical rows are omitted; this is a selected calendar, not exhaustive.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November and December Economic Indicators Calendars; Federal Reserve Board November calendar, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; Census 2026 indicators calendar; BEA news schedule; Chicago Fed calendar/NFCI page; Philadelphia Fed survey schedule; TreasuryDirect; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules. No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run; this is not a full risk review. No exchange-specific market-structure event or product-hours verification was available.
  • Yahoo is a single-source vendor quote for snapshot fields. Futures are generic continuous-series observations, not official settlements. Reconfirm live event/auction updates, market depth, trading hours and selected contract before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Friday SPY fell 1.77%, while ES=F is 0.49% above Friday's completed bar in the early Monday quote. The official 10Y close eased 4 bp to 4.94%; MOVE rose to 100.20, still within the moderate-uncertainty band, and VIX is 19.42. Today's 10:00 AM Construction and ISM Manufacturing releases are the first scheduled data catalysts. Treat early price discovery as event-sensitive; wait for live rates, volatility and liquidity confirmation. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES loses its early overnight strength without confirmation from Treasury yields, volatility or market depth; if today's data materially reprices rates; or if the selected contract's hours or liquidity differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify contract, event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
